newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel gains as NYMEX offsets lower diffs.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel gains as NYMEX offsets lower diffs.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel edged higher Friday as a half-cent gain in November NYMEX values more than offset a weakening in differentials in New York Harbor and the Gulf Coast, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade was offered at 0.50 cent over the print, 0.25 cent weaker than Thursday diffs, while low-sulfur 55-grade fuel held stable at about 3.15 cents above the screen, traders said.
Gulf 54-grade, meanwhile, was offered at 1.85 cents below the print, about 0.25 cent weaker than Thursday, players said.
